visual.name: sortingQuizV2
visual.description: Three-column matching game for the Two Marriages LEGO HP retrospective (Dataviz World Champs BCN Round 2): click a minifig, then its character name, then its era — correct chains lock in gold, wrong picks flash red. Ten rounds, five at a time; score, reveal and reset are built in. Data: disconnected QuizPool table (Rebrickable LEGO Database). Fully keyboard-operable with ARIA announcements.
